department: Department of Biological Sciences (Federated with NJIT)

deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications are due December 15, 2026 for both U.S. and non-U.S. applicants; no Spring admission is accepted.

also.quote: Ph.D. deadline: December 15 for Fall admission. No Spring admission accepted.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is optional for Ph.D. in Biology applicants.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Biology (discontinued May 2021).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students begin with coursework and two laboratory rotations during the first year to identify a thesis advisor, so prior supervisor commitment is not required.
supervisor.quote: Typical student progression through the program starts with coursework and two lab rotations. Laboratory rotations will help to identify a thesis advisor and are typically completed by the end of the first year.

also.quote: Year 1: Rotation 1 and Rotation 2, Course works

funding.value: Most full-time Ph.D. students in the Biology program receive funding via Teaching or Research Assistantships providing a stipend, full tuition remission, and health insurance.
funding.quote: Most of the full-time Ph.D. students in the Biology Graduate Program receive funding either in the form of Graduate Teaching Assistanship or Research Assistanships, which provide a stipend, full tuition remission and health insurance.

entry_route.value: The Biology Ph.D. admissions page lists degree transcripts but does not explicitly state whether a bachelor's or master's degree is the required entry route.

notes: Federated Department of Biological Sciences between Rutgers-Newark and NJIT. Track specializations include Cell & Molecular Biology, Ecology & Evolution, and Neurobiology.
name: Ph.D. in Biology
